captions.detailed: A clinical monocular microscope featuring a light gray cast base, a dark gray cylindrical vertical column, and a light gray focusing carriage. It includes an inclined monocular eyepiece tube with a black eyepiece, a rotating objective turret with black nosepiece lenses, a black rectangular slide stage, and a dark gray condenser housing beneath the stage with a small rotating diaphragm lever. The focusing carriage slides vertically on the column, the lens turret rotates continuously, the stage translates front-to-back, and the diaphragm lever pivots horizontally.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a clinical monocular microscope with a cast base, vertical column, sliding focusing carriage, and a rectangular stage. Incorporate an inclined eyepiece tube, a rotating nosepiece turret, and a pivoting diaphragm lever underneath the stage, using a light gray, dark gray, and black color scheme.
captions.factory: Construct the microscope using an ArticulatedObject builder. Model the base by unioning box and cylinder primitives, and attach a vertical cylinder for the pillar. Create the focusing carriage as a prismatic joint sliding on the pillar. Mount the inclined monocular tube and rotating objective nosepiece to the carriage. Create the slide stage as a prismatic joint moving front-to-back on the carriage guides. Finally, attach the condenser housing beneath the stage and add a revolute joint for the diaphragm lever.
